$comment: FORM P5 admission, 2026-11-18. screenAction.moveTo (drag-to-column on a board) is NOT admitted: no corpus app uses it yet.

declarative.why: a button: label, the flow it starts, its input mapping ($row/$form), an optional confirm question and the screen to open next

notLower.why: starting a flow from a browser is the one route POST /api/x/flows/<flow>/execute, which only answers for a flow that is an action of a screen of the caller's experience; that gate cannot be written in a flow or function

enforced.note: probe 19 proves the execute route: 200 for a screen action, 404 for an internal flow, a role outside `for`, or a flow no screen names; ExperienceValidationTest checks the flow exists and is expose ui|api; visibleWhen is evaluated by /api/x/eval (probe 20 covers that endpoint for badges)

taught.bundleLine: `"actions":[{"label":"Accept","flow":"AcceptOffer","input":{"id":"$row.id"}}]` ... every button starts a flow with `"expose":"ui"` (or `api`) ... button `confirm`/`visibleWhen`/`then`
